verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own Marketing API documents adding a contact to an audience, which counts as programmatically updating list membership. Nothing in the evidence shows creating or updating segments, tags or lists themselves, or reading back member lists. Predictive Segmentation is listed only as a plan feature, and audience webhooks are adjacent sync tools, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented segment and tag create/update endpoints, list creation endpoint, endpoint to read segment, tag or list membership, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: Create a new omni-channel contact for an audience.
Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.
